items.en: Clearer, more consistent wording across the app in English and Chinese.
items.zh: 统一并优化了多处界面文案，中英文表述更清晰一致。

items.en: The gradebook now shows each Canvas assignment's submission status, filters by To do, Awaiting grade and Graded like the Canvas tab, sorts by score, and opens assignments in Canvas; excused assignments no longer count.
items.zh: 成绩册新增 Canvas 作业的提交状态，可按待完成、待出分、已出分筛选（与 Canvas 页签一致）、按得分排序并在 Canvas 中打开作业；免交的作业不再计入成绩。

items.en: Ask Sem about a file right beside its preview, with citations that turn to the cited page.
items.zh: 预览文件时可以在旁边直接就这份文件向 Sem 提问，点回答里的出处即可翻到对应页面。

items.en: LMS sync is faster: several courses sync side by side and each course needs fewer requests.
items.zh: LMS 同步更快：多门课程可同时同步，每门课需要的请求也更少。
